titleZh: 无为 1.7.44：一人公司与生图模型上线
titleEn: Wuwei 1.7.44: My Company and image generation
bodyZh:
一人公司
让 AI 员工分工协作，帮你写代码、做设计、处理文案和数据。新用户默认开启，侧栏可直接找到 CEO办公室、技术部、设计部和综合部。点击员工开始私聊，也可以建群一起完成任务。

已有用户可在「设置 → 一人公司」开启；暂无员工时，进入「一人公司」页面安装默认团队。

生图模型
登录后，点击输入框下方的平台，选择「无为托管 · 生图模型」，再选择 GPT Image 2、Nano Banana 2、Nano Banana 或 GPT Image 1。输入图片描述并发送，确认无为币费用后开始生成，图片会直接显示在对话中，无需配置 API Key。

请更新到 1.7.44，重启后使用。
bodyEn:
My Company
Work with AI teammates on coding, design, writing and data. It is on by default for new users, with CEO Office, Engineering, Design and General Affairs in the sidebar. Click a teammate to chat, or create a group to work together.

Existing users can turn it on in Settings → Company → Enable My Company. If the roster is empty, open My Company and install the default team.

Image generation
Sign in, click the platform below the message box and choose Wuwei hosted · Image models. Select GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana or GPT Image 1. Describe your image and send. Confirm the coin cost to generate; the image appears directly in the conversation. No API key setup is needed.

Update to 1.7.44 and restart to use these features.
